title: Harvest of Thrones Episode 5
last_recap: Determined, the farmer strides through marble arches, mud dripping, torchlight dancing, while distant thunder rattles ancient stones. Tense, his jaw tightens as the king's decree reverberates, crystal humming, courtiers hushed, shadows flickering against stone. Wary, he grasps his copper amulet, rain drumming windows, candles melting, scrolls rustling, as council eyes pierce him. Conflicted, his hand hovers over the king's demand, crystal glow shimmering, gold filigree glinting, murmurs swelling around him. Resolute, he climbs the raised platform, wind howls through cracked arches, torn banner
ending_cliffhanger: Defiant, he emerges clutching the sigil, crystal shards glitter, guards tremble, rain hammers windows, kingdom holding breath.
